descricao: “As someone who was born in the Backrooms, I never understood why so many people desperately want to return to the Earth. The infinite expanses of the hundreds of levels provide endless supplies and places for everyone to live. Isn’t that far more appealing? …After being trapped in this bloody level for thirteen years, getting separated from everyone I love, from the reality I once knew, even if I supposedly have everything I need to survive, it is just… agonising. I now understand that burning desire to go home.” ~ Extract from Amelia Webster’s journal.
